data.long_meaning: Naeema is an elegant Arabic name meaning 'tranquil', 'soft', or 'comforting'. It reflects a peaceful soul that brings calmness to those around her. The name Naeema carries the meaning “Tranquil, Soft, Comforting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Naeema usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquil, soft, comforting and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.long_meaning: Naeema is an Arabic name that means beautiful, gentle, soft, kind, lovely, charming, pleasant, agreeable, pleasing, and well-liked. The name Naeema is derived from the Arabic root 'n-a' which means to be happy, pleased, or content. It is also related to the Arabic word 'na'imah' which means happiness or joy. In Islamic tradition, Naeema is considered a blessed name, associated with the qualities of kindness, compassion, and gentleness. It is also believed to bring good fortune and happiness to the bearer.
